method.what: SSO woodwinds' and brass' All techniques Long (UACC CC32 = 1) against CC1, every 3 semitones over the Long's sounding range (sso_sound_range.json), plus each patch's test pitch (the map's pitch=): the 23 main patches (solo, a2, a6) of the twelve instruments the TU Berlin database measured (real_range.py WINDS)
method.measured: 2026-10-14 on the Windows 11 test VM, the real Spitfire Symphony Orchestra in Kontakt Player 8.13.1 (VST 3), offline, by the VM's test host kthost (MD5 ea7e692e; one process per patch, so one transport start each, 44.1 kHz stereo float, 512-frame blocks split at each event as MuseScore does)
method.setups: the setups MuseScore made from each patch's .nki for its dynamics check (maker 2, $iooxo=3), resaved by Kontakt, unedited (the VM's background dynamics check setups, copied; Bass Trombone Solo, missing there, from the rest check's, made the same way 2026-09-30): the library's defaults
method.events: as sso_cc1_curves.json: CC32 1 and CC11 127 once; a warm-up note (not measured); then per pitch, per CC1 value, 4 notes in a row, held 3.0 s, 1.5 s apart, velocity = CC1, CC1 sent 1 s before its note-on
method.takes: 4 per point: the takes of one round robin are identical (within 0.01 dB), and the patches alternate two round robins (rmsDbTakes A B A B; A - B median 0.4-1.7 dB per patch, up to 8.5 dB at one point), except Oboes a2 and Clarinet Solo (all four takes identical: one sample per point), so 4 takes play each round robin twice and the median is their mean exactly; more takes would add nothing. One process per patch: the round robins' order is the one a transport start gives

measures.rmsDb: mean power of both channels 1.5-3.0 s after the note-on, dB full scale
measures.lufs: ITU-R BS.1770-4 integrated loudness (pyloudnorm 0.2.0) of the note-on to the note-off, LUFS
measures.sones: ISO 532-1 stationary loudness (mosqito 1.2.1 loudness_zwst, free field, resampled to 48 kHz) of the mid channel 1.5-3.0 s after the note-on, samples as pascals: only ratios mean anything
measures.loudDb: the dynamics check's measure: the loudest 50 ms (25 ms hop) of the note and 0.5 s of its release
measures.loud1sDb: the same over the note's first 1.0 s and 0.5 s more

method.points: per pitch, per CC1: the median of the 4 takes and their spread (max - min); rmsDbTakes each take's rmsDb in the order played
method.relative64: per measure: [cc, median over pitches of (value - value at CC1 64; sones: ratio), min, max, pitches, median repeat spread, largest repeat spread]
